research_rationale:
EO 12908 of April 22, 1994, Order of Succession of Officers To Act as Secretary of the Army (59 FR 21907, FR Doc. 94-10241), was read in full from the held Federal Register text. Section 1 designates, in order, the Under Secretary of the Army, the Assistant Secretaries and General Counsel of the Army, and the Chief of Staff of the Army to act for the Secretary of the Army on death, permanent disability or resignation (paragraph (a)) or on absence or temporary disability (paragraph (b)), with precedence and acting-officer limits in paragraphs (c) and (d); section 2 states that succession is temporary or interim and does not vacate the successor's statutory appointment. The order is a standing designation with no end date. No held instrument amends, revokes or supersedes it: the bounded searches located none, and the only held text that cites its number is its own Federal Register and APP printing. The dossier's clause inventory omitted section 2 (the dossier span stopped inside the page break within paragraph (d)); the inventory is corrected to ten clauses covering sections 1 and 2, with the heading line of section 1 merged into paragraph (a). All ten clauses are operative on 2026-10-14.
